description: Visitors, Google search and leads for one of the customer's websites (Site Insights). Needs serviceId; rangeDays 7, 28 or 90. growth: the last 12 complete weeks (visitors, sessions, Google clicks, impressions, position, submitted pages and the sampled share of pages Google has indexed, shop orders) with change vs the previous 4 weeks and the pages and searches that grew or fell most. view server: stats from the web server itself (works without Google): visitors, page views, the gap to Google Analytics, bandwidth, errors and top missing pages, human vs bot traffic, AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and others: last visit and the pages they read), top pages, referrers, devices and security signals (busiest networks, login and xmlrpc attempts).

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id of the website.

view.description: google (default): Analytics and Search Console. server: stats from the web server access logs, no Google needed.
